description: This file defines the interface and data structures for managing Kernel Mode Setting (KMS) in a DRM (Direct Rendering Manager) environment. It includes definitions for a context structure, function prototypes for setting up, tearing down, and querying DRM objects like connectors, encoders, CRTCs, and planes. It also references external DRM libraries.
external_methods: drmModeObjectProperties* drmModeObjectGetProperties(int fd, uint32_t obj_id, uint32_t obj_type)
published: uint32_t kms_get_properties(int fd, drmModeObjectProperties *props, const char *name)

methods.name: kms_setup
methods.description: Creates and initializes a KMS context structure, setting up necessary DRM resources.

methods.name: kms_cleanup_context
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a KMS context.

methods.name: kms_setup_encoder
methods.description: Configures the encoder in the KMS context, likely selecting a suitable encoder for the device.

methods.name: kms_setup_connector
methods.description: Sets up the connector in the KMS context, selecting a display connector.

methods.name: kms_setup_crtc
methods.description: Assigns or configures the CRTC (display controller) in the KMS context.

methods.name: kms_get_properties
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property ID by name for a DRM object.

methods.name: kms_get_plane
methods.description: Retrieves primary and overlay plane IDs for the device, setting them within the KMS context.
